'''Season 7''' of '''[[Dana White's Contender Series]]''' commences in August 2023 and in the US is exclusive to [[ESPN+]], [[ESPN]]'s new over-the-top subscription package.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-11 |title=Dana White's Contender Series, Season 7 roster filling up for summer 2023 launch |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/lists/ufc-news-dana-whites-contender-series-2023-season-7-roster |access-date=2024-08-27 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Week 1 – August 8 ==
===Background===
[[Joshua Van]] was expected to face Kevin Borjas in a flyweight bout at the event, but he was pulled in order to face [[Zhalgas Zhumagulov]] at [[UFC on ABC: Emmett vs. Topuria]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2023/6/15/23762652/zhalgas-zhumagulov-vs-felipe-bunes-off-ufc-vegas-75-zhumagulov-to-fight-joshua-van-ufc-jacksonville|title=Zhalgas Zhumagulov vs. Felipe Bunes off UFC Vegas 75, Zhumagulov to fight Joshua Van at UFC Jacksonville|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2023-06-15|access-date=2023-06-15}}</ref> He was replaced by Rickson Zenidim.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dpontanews.com.br/pontagrossa/lutador-ponta-grossense-de-mma-representa-o-brasil-no-ufc/|title=MMA fighter from Ponta Grossa represents Brazil in the UFC, in the United States|publisher=dpontanews.com.br|author=Staff|date=2023-06-19|access-date=2023-06-19}}{{in lang|pt-br}}</ref> However, Zenidim had visa issues and was replaced by Victor Dias.

== Week 3 – August 22 ==
===Background===
Edgar Chairez was expected to face Felipe dos Santos in a flyweight bout at the event, but he was pulled in order to face Tatsuro Taira at [[UFC 290]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/06/ufc-290-tatsuro-taira-rebooked-after-last-minute-cancellation|title=Tatsuro Taira quickly rebooked for UFC 290 after recent last-minute cancellation|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2023-06-27|access-date=2023-06-27}}</ref> He was briefly replaced by Luciano Pereira. At the weigh-ins, Pereira did not step onto the scale due to a medical issue and the bout was scrapped entirely.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2023/8/21/23840229/dana-whites-contender-series-week-3-down-to-4-fights-after-one-bout-scrapped-at-weigh-ins|title=Dana White’s Contender Series Week 3 down to 4 fights after one bout scrapped at weigh-ins|website=MMA Fighting|author=Damon Martin|date=2023-08-21|access-date=2023-08-21}}</ref>

== Week 4 – August 29 ==
===Background===
Val Woodburn was expected to face Marco Tulio Silva in a middleweight bout at the event, but he was pulled in order to face [[Bo Nickal]] at [[UFC 290]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/07/ufc-290-bo-nickal-vs-valentine-woodburn-booked-late-replacement|title=Bo Nickal gets newcomer Val Woodburn at UFC 290 as late replacement|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2023-07-04|access-date=2023-07-04}}</ref> He was replaced by [[Yousri Belgaroui]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/yousri-belgaroui-common-kickboxing-foe-220036152.html|title=Yousri Belgaroui, common kickboxing foe of Adesanya and Pereira, heads to Dana White’s Contender Series|publisher=sports.yahoo.com|author=Nolan King|date=2023-07-13|access-date=2023-07-13}}</ref>

== Week 5 – September 5 ==
===Background===
Corinne Laframboise was expected to face Rainn Guerrero in a women's flyweight bout at the event, but she was pulled after discovering she was pregnant during pre-fight medical screenings. She was replaced by Dione Barbosa.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2023/9/2/23856775/surprise-surprise-contender-series-removed-dana-whites-show-after-test-three-months-pregnant-ufc|title=‘Surprise, surprise!’ Contender Series hopeful hastily removed from Dana White’s show after test reveals she’s three months pregnant|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Dan Hiergesell|date=2023-09-02|access-date=2023-09-02}}</ref> Cam Rowston was expected to face Chad Hanekom in a middleweight bout but was replaced by Dylan Budka for unknown reasons.{{Citation needed|date=September 2023}}
